::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru startup led by Chairman and CEO Alok Sharma (formerly Ericsson; Sequans board 2011-22, per company site) developing 5G/LTE-Advanced chipsets and sub-6 GHz/mmWave RF transceivers, with designs it says are compatible with Tata Electronics' planned 28/22nm process. Exhibited at Semicon India 2026 and was among indigenous chip firms at a DoT conclave in Nov 2026 seeking market support for domestic telecom chipsets. No tape-out publicly reported.
:::

## What does this firm design?

5G/LTE-Advanced baseband chipsets and RF transceivers with a full software stack.
